faq_heading: Homes near Coyote Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Coyote Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Coyote Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Coyote Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Coyote Creek Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 84 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,520,000, townhomes $811,000, condos $565,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Coyote Creek Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Coyote Creek Elementary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 84 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Coyote Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Fleetwood Park Secondary (0.4 km south), Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km east) and Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km north-east).

Coyote Creek Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 8131 156 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Coyote Creek Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Coyote Creek Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Coyote Creek Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Coyote Creek Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 84 homes sold within 1 km of Coyote Creek Elementary: 17 houses, 44 townhomes and 23 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $811,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Coyote Creek Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Coyote Creek Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is Fleetwood Park Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Gobind Sarvar School, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Walnut Road Elementary (1.2 km east), Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km north-east), Maple Green Elementary (1.6 km north-west), William Watson Elementary (1.8 km east), St Matthew's Elementary (1.8 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Walnut Road Elementary, 1.2 km east of Coyote Creek Elementary.
